The '''Keizar-Volvec bulk cruiser''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] used by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Characteristics==
The ship was described as a "behemoth," and held multiple wings of [[B28 Extinction-class bomber|B28 ''Extinction''-class bombers]], [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|ISF Starfighters]], [[VT-22 light troop transport|VT-22 transports]], and shuttles. Its nose was described as hollow with a large hangar bay, and the ship also possessed a quarantine bay.

==History==
The ''[[Paramount]]'' was a [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] of this kind, used as a [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Chratis]] during [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]].
